NT1_frozen_metric.note: published cells are 6-dp rounded; deviations at 1e-6 are rounding, not disagreement.

cost_constants.unit_definition: 1.0 FLOP-eq = one Lingshu-7B cap320 open-text forward+generate = 5.6927 TFLOP (resolution_sweep_2026-08-13.json cost.open_half_per_candidate.cap320.flops_per_candidate)

verifier_geometry_tokens.title: Verifier prompt geometry for Attack 3 convention C (verifier prefix sharing)
verifier_geometry_tokens.provenance: measured (tokenizer) + measured (cap320 prompt geometry from flop_ratio_derivation)
verifier_geometry_tokens.definition: shared_prefix = everything up to and including 'Proposed answer: ' (image tokens + verifier system prompt + question + marker).  per_candidate_suffix = the candidate answer text + 'Is the proposed answer correct? Answer Yes or No.' + the assistant turn opener -- the only part a prefix-caching verifier has to recompute for candidate k>1.
verifier_geometry_tokens.cost_units_provenance: derived from the N2 FLOP model + the measured token geometry above

provenance.head_pass: computed with flop_ratio_derivation.forward_flops on the feature cache's OWN geometry: feats_hidden/generator_eval_s0of2.meta.json max_pixels=1003520, generator prompt + candidate answer, G=1 (teacher forced)
